notes:
What's new in 0.1.59:
• AV1 streaming support (optional, better picture quality)
• More video and audio file types recognized in your library
• RAW camera photo support: Canon, Nikon, Sony, Olympus, Fujifilm
• Subtitle timing adjustment slider
• Titles/descriptions now show in your chosen language
• Kids Mode and Easy Mode: simplified layouts for a child or a relative who finds the app overwhelming
• Family Viewing mode: one click to temporarily apply strict parental settings for everyone
• Spoiler-safe mode: hides episode details until you've watched them
• Summon: message and pause household members' video
• Music sleep timer
• .nfo file export for other media tools
• Fixed a privacy issue with the Photos map view (no longer contacts a third party directly)
• Prepare a video for streaming ahead of time, one at a time
• Reliability and security improvements
